capabilities.description: Spawn an actor from a Blueprint asset. Provide the Blueprint name or full path (e.g. /Game/Blueprints/MyBP).
Delete an actor from the level by name.

name.description: Name or label of the actor to delete

capabilities.description: Find actors whose name or label contains the given pattern (case-insensitive substring match).
List all actors in the current editor level with their transforms.
Get all editable UPROPERTY values for an actor (bools, ints, floats, strings, enums).
Set a single UPROPERTY on an actor by name. Supports bool, int, float, string, byte/enum.

value.description: New value (strings, numbers, booleans all accepted)

capabilities.description: Spawn an actor in the editor level. Supported types: StaticMeshActor, PointLight, SpotLight, DirectionalLight, CameraActor.
Set an actor's location, rotation, and/or scale. Only supplied fields are changed.
Execute a UE console command in the editor (e.g. 'stat fps', 'r.ScreenPercentage 100'). Some commands are blocked for safety.
Remove all foliage instances within a bounding region.

bounds_min.description: { x, y, z } minimum bounds corner

bounds_max.description: { x, y, z } maximum bounds corner

capabilities.description: List all foliage types and their instance counts in the current level.
Scatter foliage instances of a static mesh randomly within bounds.

mesh.description: Asset path of the Static Mesh to scatter

bounds_min.description: { x, y, z } minimum bounds corner

bounds_max.description: { x, y, z } maximum bounds corner

align_to_normal.description: Align instances to surface normal via trace (default: true)

capabilities.description: Create and register a new foliage type asset from a static mesh.

mesh.description: Asset path of the Static Mesh

name.description: Name for the foliage type asset (default: derived from mesh)

capabilities.description: Get information about the currently loaded level: name, actor count, and world settings.
Load a map file into the editor. Path must start with /Game/ (e.g. /Game/Maps/MyLevel).
Spawn a NavMeshBoundsVolume at the given location and extent.

extent.description: { x, y, z } half-extent of the bounds volume

capabilities.description: Rebuild navigation mesh within the specified bounds (or full rebuild if no bounds given).

bounds_min.description: { x, y, z } minimum bounds (optional, omit for full rebuild)

bounds_max.description: { x, y, z } maximum bounds (optional, omit for full rebuild)

capabilities.description: Get statistics about the current navigation mesh (tile count, bounds, etc.).
Spawn a Nav Modifier Volume that changes the navigation area class within a region.
Test if a navigation path exists between two points and return the path details.
Read recent lines from the Unreal Editor output log. Supports optional text filter.

lines.description: Number of lines to return (default 100, max 2000)

capabilities.description: Restart Play In Editor. If PIE is running, the next session starts only after the current play world has fully stopped.
Request a Play In Editor session in the active level viewport.
Request the active Play In Editor session to stop, or cancel a queued start.
Capture the active editor viewport as a JPEG image and return it as base64. Useful for visual inspection of the scene.
Create a semicircular arch from cubes in the XZ plane.
Create a modular castle with outer walls, corner towers, a central keep, a gatehouse, and a moat ring.

size.description: small, medium, large, or epic (default medium)

capabilities.description: Create a house with walls, floor, roof, and door opening. Styles: modern, cottage.
Generate a solvable maze using recursive backtracking. Creates walls from cubes with an entrance and exit.
Create a stepped pyramid from cubes. Each level shrinks by one block in X and Y.

base_size.description: Base size in blocks per side (default 3)

capabilities.description: Create a staircase from cubes. Each step advances in X and rises in Z.

step_size.description: [width, depth, height] per step in cm (default [100,100,50])

capabilities.description: Create a tower. Styles: cylindrical, square, tapered. Blocks are placed as a shell at each level.
Generate a town with a street grid, randomized buildings, street lights, and a central plaza.

size.description: small, medium, large, or metropolis (default medium)

capabilities.description: Create a wall from cubes. Specify length (blocks), height (blocks), orientation (x or y), and block_size.

block_size.description: Size of each block in cm (default 100)

capabilities.description: Return the current PIE lifecycle state, session identifier, and generation.
Pause the active PIE session and return its updated lifecycle state.
Resume a paused PIE session and return its updated lifecycle state.
List Editor, PIE, Game, and Preview world contexts with stable world identifiers and write eligibility.
Find runtime UObjects in PIE or Game worlds and return session-scoped opaque object references.
Read selected reflected properties from a session-scoped runtime object.
Set one supported reflected property on a PIE or Game runtime object.

value.description: JSON-compatible value for the reflected property

capabilities.description: Invoke a permitted non-latent BlueprintCallable or BlueprintEvent UFunction on a PIE or Game object.
Read a runtime UserWidget tree with object references and current widget state.
Read runtime widget visibility, enabled state, geometry, focus, and interaction state.
Return the Slate hit-test path for a runtime widget or an explicit viewport position.
Set keyboard focus to a runtime widget for a local Slate user.
List supported dynamic delegates on a runtime object and report their signatures and binding state.
Bind a signature-compatible function target to a supported dynamic runtime delegate.
Remove one dynamic runtime delegate binding identified by target object and function.
Check whether one target function is bound to a supported dynamic runtime delegate.
Broadcast a supported dynamic multicast delegate with signature-validated arguments.
Dispatch a real Slate pointer action through the Automation Driver to a runtime widget or viewport position.
Dispatch a real Slate keyboard action through the Automation Driver, optionally targeting a runtime widget.
Set the local player's input mode, focus widget, cursor visibility, and mouse lock behavior in PIE.
Describe the current editor world's World Partition and streaming state.
List bounded generated World Partition runtime cells and their current states.
List active World Partition streaming sources.
Audit the current World Partition streaming configuration and observed sources.
List Data Layer instances and effective runtime state in the current world.
Get one Data Layer instance by short name, full name, instance name, or path.
Audit World Partition HLOD actor presence without starting a build.
Inspect PCG components through optional-module reflection; returns unavailable when PCG is not loaded.
Get the active RHI, adapter, feature level, world, and ray tracing hardware signal.
Audit current Lumen, Nanite, VSM, hardware ray tracing, and TSR CVar/RHI evidence.
Take one instantaneous RHI texture and graphics-memory sample with availability flags.
Plan a reversible World Partition streaming or runtime Data Layer state change.
Execute an approved World Partition change after re-planning and exact digest validation.
Rollback a recorded World Partition change in the same Editor instance.
Plan an allowlisted, session-scoped render setting change.
Execute an approved allowlisted session render setting change.
Rollback a recorded session render setting change in the same Editor instance.
Start an approved WorldPartitionHLODsBuilder commandlet job for the current saved map.
Schedule GenerateLocal on bounded PCG components in the current Editor world; never executes inside Workflow.
Schedule CleanupLocal on bounded PCG components in the current Editor world; never executes inside Workflow.
